watches.name: 300mD-Red
watches.description: As many watch enthusiasts know, the perfect Dive watch is a matter of taste, style, function as well as budget. We set out to create that perfect balance of function, style, and quality you would expect from a high-end Dive Watch. Our watch case is a little different than the ordinary, at 42 mm we believe it’s the perfect size and with the turned down lugs fits like a 40mm or 41mm. All crafted from 316L Stainless Steel. With an exceptionally high quality Stainless steel bracelet that fits perfectly with the case design. Utilizing screw pins to secure the links you will know this bracelet is not going anywhere once you attach it to your wrist. With three micro adjustments in the diver signed clasp. With a 316L Stainless Steel COG style 120 click one directional bezel and aluminum insert. With crisp clean clicks and no back play, this tool watch is ready to work. BGW9 Lume on the mesmerizing mother of pearl dial. This watch is not only functional and sound but beautiful as well. And to “Top it Off” we have a sapphire crystal. These are cut with diamond saws, grind-ed and polished to the finished “glass” product. Sapphire crystal is 8-9 on the Mohs scale, being nearly un-scratchable. Specifications Case: 316L Stainless Steel Dial: Red Mother of Pearl Strap: Stainless Steel 22-20 mm taper Movement: NH35 Automatic Mechanical Movement Glass: Sapphire Crystal Water Resistance: 30 ATM Size: 42mm Thickness: Case, sapphire glass, caseback 13.5mm 120 Click uni directional bezel Stainless Steel 30 ATM - 300 Meter - 996 feet of Water Resistance Luminosity BGW9 Super Luminova

watches.name: 100m GMT Sport (Red Dial)
watches.description: Now Available!!!! Blue MOP Dial White MOP Dial The UGLY Watch Co. is proud to introduce our first GMT. The 100m GMT Sport Diver. This timepiece combines The UGLY Watch Co’s distinctive design, distinguished by refined and robust features, with a new complication standing for technical innovation, the GMT function. The 100m GMT Sport Diver keeps the brand's most distinguishing characteristics while adding momentous new features including the NH34 GMT Automatic movement, a re-imagining of the classic GMT watches, is influenced by the earliest sports watches from the 1950s and 60s while adding a little pop of color. The UGLY Watch Co. will be able to extend our horizons with a sportier style of the 100m GMT Sport Diver that will certainly become one of the must-haves for 2023 thanks to the GMT function, which has established itself as a benchmark in terms of horological complications. The idea doesn't need to be explained. Utilizing a unidirectional rotating bezel, the 100m GMT uses a center hand with a cuneate point to represent the reference time (home time) when traveling, on a scale of 24 hours. All of this is in addition to the standard hour and minute display for the location where we are (local time). The Bezel: The 100m GMT Sport Diver With a 316L Stainless Steel COG style 120 click one directional bezel and aluminum 24hr bezel insert. With crisp clean clicks and no back play, this GMT watch is ready to travel. Utilizing BGW9 Lume on the hour markers and hands illuminate the mesmerizing mother of pearl dials. The Dials: The 100m GMT Sport Diver offers Three Mother of Pearl Dial colors to choose from (Red, White, or Blue). Mother of pearl is the iridescent lining you find on the inside of a shell. Nacre, another name for mother-of-pearl, is in fact a blend of minerals including calcium carbonate secreted by oysters and molluscs to protect their homes from parasites and foreign objects. If a foreign object makes its way into the shell, the mollusc secretes layer upon layer of nacre, eventually producing a pearl. The Crystal: Sapphire glass on the 100m GMT Sport Diver, is made synthetically and is actually considered a glass not a crystal. The sapphire crystal is made in very high temperatures and is made up from crystalline aluminum oxides. These are then cut with diamond saws, grind-ed and polished to the finished “glass” product. Sapphire crystal is 8-9 on the Mohs scale, being nearly un-scratchable. The Bracelet: The Jubilee style bracelet on the 100m GMT Sport Diver is made of solid 316L stainless steel. Screw-in adjustable construction instead of pressure pins to keep it solid and stable. The UGLY Watch Co . is paying homage to the golden age of Sport Watch history by re-imagining the well-known classic style and adding a new take on the affordable luxury Sport Watch. It has a little larger 41mm case than the 36-38mm cases from the 70s and 80s, to satisfy modern tastes that gravitate toward styles with a larger case design while preserving the shapely silhouette inherited from the vintage sport watch style, staying loyal to the original essence. As a Microbrand watch company, The UGLY Watch Co. promotes the spirit of defying the current status quo and distinguishing our unique Sport Watch look from others on the market today. We are honored to share our passion for preserving the history of classic dress, yet casual sport watch while paying homage to classic styles from the past. watches.name: The "RM3"
watches.description: The Rista Marka III (RM3) Inspired by both classic and modern horology, the Rista Marka line draws influence from vintage pilot watches, professional dive watches, and extravagant luxury timepieces. The name “Rista Marka” originates from Old Norse, loosely translating to “Marked Beauty” — a name that perfectly reflects the identity of this collection. With the RM3, we brought those inspirations together into a single timepiece. Bold, mechanical, and unapologetically distinctive, the RM3 was designed to capture the raw character of traditional chronographs while maintaining the aggressive design language that defines UGLY Watch Co. The Movement — ST1901 At the heart of the RM3 is the legendary ST1901 mechanical chronograph movement — a movement deeply rooted in traditional watchmaking history. Unlike modular chronographs, the ST1901 features an integrated chronograph architecture, meaning the chronograph mechanism is built directly into the movement itself rather than added on top as a separate module. This traditional construction method is more complex and labor-intensive, but it creates a more refined and cohesive mechanical system. The ST1901 also utilizes a column wheel chronograph mechanism, widely regarded as the superior approach in mechanical chronograph design. Requiring extremely precise tolerances and significantly more effort to manufacture than common cam-actuated systems, the column wheel delivers a smoother, more precise chronograph engagement with a distinctly satisfying mechanical feel. For enthusiasts who appreciate traditional mechanical engineering, the ST1901 is truly the centerpiece of the RM3. The Case back: Continuing the Rista Marka tradition, the RM3 features a beautifully engraved exhibition caseback designed to showcase the movement as the true centerpiece of the watch. Surrounding the sapphire exhibition glass is an intricate engraved pattern that adds depth and character while allowing the ST1901 movement to remain the star of the show. While the RM3 is powered by a manual wind movement, we intentionally retained the “AUTOMATIC” engraving around the caseback as part of the established Rista Marka design language — preserving the visual identity that collectors have come to recognize. The Dial: The RM3 carries forward the unmistakable Rista Marka aesthetic with its crisp white dial and balanced chronograph layout. The UGLY Watch Co. logo sits proudly at the 12 o’clock position, while the RM3 designation is positioned above the 6 o’clock lume marker. Contrasting black chronograph subdials occupy the 3 and 9 o’clock positions, creating a bold motorsport-inspired appearance while enhancing legibility. Applied lume plots at the remaining hour positions, paired with diamond-cut hands finished in C3 lume, ensure strong low-light visibility while adding dimension and detail to the dial. The result is a dial that feels both mechanical and aggressive — clean enough for everyday wear, yet distinctive enough to stand apart immediately on the wrist. Specifications Movement: ST1901 Mechanical Chronograph Movement Complications: Chronograph Case Material: 316L Stainless Steel Case Size: 42mm (excluding crown) Lug to Lug: 51mm Water Resistance: 200M Crystal: Sapphire Crystal Hands: Diamond-Cut Hands with C3 Lume Crown: 6.5mm Screw-Down Crown with Crown Guards Strap: Crazy Horse Genuine Leather Strap Width: 22mm Lume: C3 Caseback: Engraved Exhibition Caseback

watches.name: Vintage Media 2
watches.description: Introducing our Vintage Media inspired watches. One part Vintage Color TV and one part Drive in Movie, these two designs are sure to bring a smile to your face every day you wear them. The colorful zigzag pattern on our VM1 was inspired by the scrambled screen on those round vintage color TV's. As far as the VM2, you're always right on time; not a minute too soon or a second too late. The all to familiar Drive in Movie Countdown. Both share the same roundish square stainless steel case and stainless steel tapered bracelet. Measuring at only 10.4 mm thick and 41mm width, these two watches are hit dressing up or down.
